scope: Pure synthetic design and qualification; no new controller or runtime effects.

compatibility.change: Reference request now requires available_at at all nested boundaries.
compatibility.existing_consumer_behavior: Old fixtures without available_at reject rather than assume historical availability. Only this owned reference composition is changed; no shared contract retrofit.
compatibility.migration: Callers must supply verified availability of the exact revision; unknown must not be inferred from observed_at.
compatibility.prior_evidence: Previous seven-case evidence remains immutable in assessed_head.

acceptance: observed_at <= as_of < available_at rejects with not_available_at_cutoff
available_at == as_of accepts when other predicates pass
missing, null and invalid availability reject input
dispositions.limits: Synthetic available_at represents first external publication of the exact revision. Local ingested_at and historical local access are separate requirements, deferred pending consuming owner policy.

dispositions.gate: Before any future effect, compare qualified immutable source revision and canonical payload digest with current source identity. Changed or unknown identity stops the effect and requires new qualification; never substitute latest bytes silently.
acceptance: Qualify revision A; observe revision B immediately before effect; assert no effect and requalification_required
Unknown current identity must assert no effect
Unchanged revision and digest is necessary but not sufficient for effect authorization
dispositions.reason: Current harness is pure and has no authoritative readback/effect boundary; adding one here would exceed bounded reference scope.

dispositions.gate: Historical qualification conveys no present permission. Revalidate explicit action, target and permission immediately before a future effect; revoked, expired or unknown permission denies effects. Rechecking must be coupled to effect execution by the runtime owner to avoid a check/use race.
acceptance: Qualify while permitted; revoke permission before effect; assert zero effects
Unknown or expired permission denies effects
Successful pure qualification alone cannot authorize any effect
dispositions.reason: No permission authority or effect executor exists in this pure reference model.
